conceptNote: 赤い四隅と小さな拡大矢印で全画面化を表し、右下のチャットも画面内に収める。
prompt:
OUTPUT IMAGE: 1760 pixels wide, 1120 pixels high; 11:7 near-square landscape artboard, NOT a panorama. Leave substantial blank margins ABOVE AND BELOW the video rectangle.
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create ONE highly polished purely visual explanation graphic for a fullscreen live chat overlay browser extension. No text whatsoever. Landscape 11:7 aspect, target 1760 x 1120 pixels.
Off-white artboard, sophisticated flat red and charcoal geometry. One single large outlined landscape video canvas occupies 82% artboard width and 75% height. FOUR prominent red fullscreen L-corners frame its FOUR OUTERMOST CORNERS, emphasizing expansion of the entire video including the chat. The right corner marks lie at the FAR RIGHT of the WHOLE video, OUTSIDE and BEYOND the chat. One continuous pale warm grey video field fills the canvas.
In the canvas upper-left-middle, a medium charcoal play triangle. Inside the LOWER-RIGHT area of the canvas, one charcoal translucent-looking chat OVERLAY (matte charcoal, no gradients) is inset from right and bottom edges, about 29% canvas width by 62% canvas height. Four generous chat rows: pale small avatar dots and white message strokes, all abstract geometric horizontal bars, plus a low input line and little white send triangle at bottom. The video visibly continues AROUND and BEHIND this inset chat, making it an overlay, never a separate sidebar.
Near bottom-right outer margin, adjacent to the lower-right red corner but outside video, a SMALL single diagonal red expansion arrow points down-right to the outer corner, reinforcing fullscreen expansion. The arrow is a simple clean icon with no words or labels. Broad quiet space, elegant proportions, precise strong hierarchy, no unnecessary marks.
ABSOLUTELY NO typography: no letters, words, numbers, pseudo-text, names, logo or watermark anywhere. No mountains, scenery, people, photos, physical monitor, browser chrome, 3D, gradients, glow or glossy effects. Flat geometric explanatory diagram, striking and understandable at 440 x 280.
